type: Single compact paintover, not implemented gameplay
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / UI art-direction paintover. Edit reference screenshot 1. Preserve its EXACT dense layout and the full large arena footprint. Reference 2 is ONLY inspiration for the feeling of the indoor Robot Wars TV studio: dark steel, black studio void, elevated walkway, cage rails. NOT its robots, flames, hazard stripes or floor markings.
CRITICAL: the previous proposals failed by wasting space. No outdoor stadium, sky, grandstands, scenery bands, giant game logo, new empty margins, enlarged header, thick picture frames. Keep screenshot aspect 16:9. Every element stays inside its current bounding box. The arena MUST occupy x19%-81%, y28%-93%, exactly the same huge flat rounded rectangle. It is black and abstract, no perspective, no flooring texture. Preserve survival graphs at left/right and lower controls and statistics, readable. Preserve existing two commentators at x38%-62%,y4%-18%, same size and pixel art appearance. Preserve text bubbles either side and their text. DO NOT REDRAW layout. No new figures or self-portrait.
Requested art reskin ONLY:
1. Replace ugly orange rectangular opponent plate at x1%-17.5%,y3%-25.5% with Nico bust at EXACT SAME SCALE, mostly black background as if in a dark studio control position, small narrow tubular railing/console at its base. Keep his identity odd, balding, glasses, mustard shirt. Name 'NICO VALDÉS' in a compact expressive funky heavy slightly slanted sports-display font, a small 'LEVEL 01' tag. No large medallion, no big frame, no giant orange slab. His surroundings fade into black. A very small warm-orange rim light identifies his team.
2. LED sign stays exactly x18.5%-81.5%, y18.7%-26.5%. Black dot-matrix face with 'NICO 95% / YOU 98%' in orange and cyan. Rounded charcoal metal endcaps, only a slender overhead gantry/catwalk lip, 2 cable hangers and a tiny ladder tucked into the existing edge gap. A hanging indoor arena display, compact, not a baseball sign. No orange stripes. Sign and railings should feel physical via restrained pixel edge shading and depth, not neon software outlines.
3. In each side panel replace the three rectangular STRATEGY rows ONLY (x1%-17.5% and82.5%-99%, y49%-61%) with THREE SMALL VERTICAL PLAYING CARDS SIDE-BY-SIDE in a single row. NOT three huge stacked cards. Each has a genuine paper silhouette with slightly rounded corners, subtle thickness, bold readable short title TURN, THRUST, DIRECTION and a large simple illustration of turn arrow, impulse, straight direction arrow. No budget or costs invented. Keep card art dark charcoal with cream print, restrained orange team tabs left, cyan right. No fantasy filigree. Small 'ACTIVE CARDS' heading replaces strategy label. Right side tiny deck icon hints that cards are clickable to change live, without extra space.
4. All opponent agent dots and opponent survival line orange #F58B23. All player dots and player survival line cyan #24D0FF. No pink red agents. Keep exactly these two team colors consistently in side labels.
Style: weird but restrained 1997-2004 underground TV gameshow, indoor black studio, economical fine pixel art matching existing characters. Use BLACK as most of the background, with only a few visible steel tubes/supports in already unused pixels. Nothing encroaches on arena, graphs, text, or controls. This is a dense playable interface, not promotional concept illustration. Preserve the source screenshot's content and density.
